SourceFile
  QualifiedPackage consumer.enums
  ImportExact Local dependency.enums.Choice
  ImportExact Local dependency.enums.Packet
  ImportExact Local dependency.enums.Flag
  ImportExact Local dependency.enums.make
  ImportExact Local dependency.enums.empty
  ImportExact Local dependency.enums.packet
  ImportExact Local dependency.enums.flag
  public typealias Selected = Choice
    @NoGC
  public fun relay(value: Choice): Choice
    =
      Var value
    @NoGC
  public fun score(value: Choice): Long
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Selected.Empty()
          IntLiteral 0
        arm Selected.Pair{left, right, ..} if <guard>
          IntLiteral 0
        arm Selected.Pair{left, right, ..}
          Binary Add
            Var left
            Var right
    @NoGC
  public fun packetScore(value: Packet): Long
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Missing
          IntLiteral 0
        arm Data((left, _, right), _)
          Binary Add
            Var left
            Var right
    @NoGC
  public fun flagScore(value: Flag): Long
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Off
          IntLiteral 0
        arm On
          IntLiteral 1
    @NoGC
  public fun defaultScore(value: Choice, result: Long = <expr>): Long
    =
      Var result
    @NoGC
  public fun test(): Long
    =
      Binary Sub
        Binary Add
          Binary Add
            Binary Add
              Call score
                Call relay
                  Call make
                    IntLiteral 17
                    Unary Neg
                      IntLiteral 29
              Call packetScore
                Call packet
            Call defaultScore
              Call empty
          Call flagScore
            Call flag
        IntLiteral 1
